value.rationale: The source leaves the planar sharp stability gap as an implicit supremum over infinitely many positive modes. The theorem resolves that natural spectral selection problem for an entire unbounded continuum of real exponents, identifies the sharp coefficient and equality family, and provides a uniform checkable certificate. It is neither a one-off parameter substitution nor a mere numerical sample; the cutoff is explicitly not asserted sharp.
